listing.name: Devil May Cry — Devil May Cry Recomp (web/native) (awest813)
listing.summary: The project reports startup through Mission 1 on the dmc-port branch, natively and in a browser at 60 FPS. Gran Turismo 4 and God of War II reports do not establish Devil May Cry coverage. Full-game completion and stability remain unconfirmed. Original files and setup are described below. Portcove has not verified setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: NTSC-U SLUS-20216 ISO; exact revision/hash must be checked in HANDOFF.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Browser: the official GitHub Pages ISO picker supplies the player; select owned NTSC-U SLUS20216 ISO and play without local build/server. Native Windows: local source/code generation via documented launcher/build route; no native precompiled-player asset inferred. Keep route-specific original-data requirements.

warnings: The project reports startup through Mission 1 on the dmc-port branch, natively and in a browser at 60 FPS. Gran Turismo 4 and God of War II reports do not establish Devil May Cry coverage. Full-game completion and stability remain unconfirmed.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
